title: Longest Cycle in Graph - Solution
intuition: Return the length of the longest cycle in the graph. If no cycle exists, return -1.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
code:
def solution(edges):
    n = len(edges)
    visited = [False] * n
    longest = -1
    for i in range(n):
        if visited[i]: continue
        dist = {}
        curr = i
        step = 0
        while curr != -1:
            if curr in dist:
                longest = max(longest, step - dist[curr])
                break
            if visited[curr]: break
            visited[curr] = True
            dist[curr] = step
            curr = edges[curr]
            step += 1
    return longest
common_mistakes: DFS with step count distance markers to track visited indices inside current path traversal.
